protocol.name: zxr_workspace_v1
protocol.description:
This protocol extends ext-workspace-v1 workspaces with the spatial properties of a place: its kind, its anchoring state, its pose and bounds in space, a compositor-rendered preview source, and continuous switch transitions. It adds no workspace lifecycle of its own; grouping, activation, and enumeration remain ext-workspace-v1's.
A workspace group in this compositor corresponds to a reference frame; ext_workspace_handle_v1.assign moves a place between frames. Workspace coordinates remain opaque sort keys; spatial poses travel only through this extension.
The key words "must", "must not", "required", "shall", "shall not", "should", "should not", "recommended", "may", and "optional" in this document are to be interpreted as described in IETF RFC 2119.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the experimental phase. Backward incompatible changes may be added without bumping the major version of the extension. As such, gating usage on the protocol's presence is discouraged outside spatial-os itself.

interface.name: zxr_workspace_manager_v1
interface.description: The entry point for spatial workspace state. It extends workspaces obtained from ext_workspace_manager_v1 and reports continuous transitions between places.

entry.name: already_extended
entry.summary: the workspace already has a zxr_place_v1 object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager. Existing zxr_place_v1 objects are not affected.

request.name: get_place

description.summary: extend a workspace with spatial state

request.description: Create a zxr_place_v1 object extending the given workspace. A workspace may be extended at most once per client; a second request for the same workspace raises the already_extended error.

event.name: transition

description.summary: progress of a continuous place switch

event.description: Reports the progress of a switch between two places when the switch is continuous — a physical walk or an animated move — as a value from 0 at the source to 1 at the destination. Discrete switches send no transition events. The final state of a switch is conveyed by ext-workspace-v1 activation, not by this event reaching 1.

interface.name: zxr_place_v1
interface.description:
The spatial state of one workspace. State events are followed by a done event; this allows changes to the place state to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.
Poses are given in the compositor's local reference space: metres, y up, right-handed. Matrices are column-major arrays of 16 IEEE 754 binary32 values in native endianness.

entry.name: not_pinnable
entry.summary: pin requested on an overlay place

enum.name: kind
enum.description: The lifecycle kind of the place. A transient place exists only while it has members; a pinned place is a persistent named object that may be empty; an overlay place is attached to a body-relative frame and never competes for location-derived currency.

enum.name: anchor_state
enum.description: Whether the place's pose is bound to a persistent spatial anchor and whether that anchor is currently resolved. An unanchored place is positioned relative to its group's frame only. A pending anchor is persisted but not yet relocalized; its pose is the last known one and may change once, without animation, upon resolution.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the extension object. The underlying workspace is not affected.

request.name: pin
request.description: Ask the compositor to make the place persistent under the given name. There is no guarantee that the place will be pinned; the result is conveyed through the kind event. Pinning an overlay place raises the not_pinnable error.

request.name: get_preview
request.description: Create an image capture source whose content is a compositor-rendered preview of the place, suitable for pagers and overviews. The source behaves as an ext_image_capture_source_v1 for use with ext_image_copy_capture_manager_v1.

event.name: pose
event.description: The transform from the place's local space to the compositor's local reference space.

event.name: bounds
event.description: The place's bounding volume, as half-extents from its origin along its local axes, in metres.

event.name: entry_policy

description.summary: whether the place has an entry policy

event.description: Whether an entry policy is configured for the place. The policy's contents are configuration, not protocol.

arg.name: present
arg.summary: 1 if a policy is configured, 0 otherwise

event.name: done

description.summary: all pending place state has been sent

event.description: Sent after the state events on creation and after any later change. This allows changes to the place state to be seen as atomic, even if they happen via multiple events.
